title: 1972 Banner 20' motorhome for restoration - make offer
description_snippet: 1972 Banner motorhome on a Dodge chassis. 20'. Restoration started 20 years ago - stopped due to owner's death. Comes with awning, self-contained generator, roof air conditioner, re-upholstered captain chairs. Owned by an auto interior professional, so the restoration was going to be classic. Bathroom has shower, refinished. Has all the appropriate tanks (grey and potable water). There is no propane tank - it was really old. Heater, refrigerator that runs on propane, electric and battery. A few interior walls were replaced. Some water damage at the front drivers side. Rear passenger window is shattered from lawnmower rock, but still intact. It's been sitting since he passed, and all batteries are dead. Wheels were replaced so they are legal. Tires appear to be intact - they still have air in them. Gauge panel was replaced, but old odometer is 96818. Come with accessories, extra fabric, new parts that were never installed. Has ball hitch on back. Will accept offers.
